_meta.description: marketing-campaign-on-client (row mkt-form-campaign-tags). A web form submission reaches the contact and client record: TouchpointService::recordSubmission appends the touchpoint with the client and the landing page, then writes firstTouch once and lastTouch on every submission on the contact and on its client (board PqKlant, Identity: Form, Landing page, Campaign). Both touches are read only in forms; only the intake writes them. touchpoint schema version 1.0.0->1.1.0. No property changes type and none becomes required.
